tweets.text:
If you’ve ever wondered why we will need 100X more AI inference in the future, and  what it’s going to be driven by, this is another good example. 

Devin pushes forward an idea of agentic mapreduce, which means we’ll now have swarms of agents that are processing large amounts of data (code) to handle tasks that humans never could have done before.

“Devin maps relevant signals across the repo, fans out focused agents over bounded shards, reduces their findings into one report, then verifies serious vulnerabilities in isolated sandboxes before marking them confirmed.”

In this case it’s code security, but there are tons of other use-cases in code and knowledge work. We see this at Box with customers that want to process and understand millions of documents for risk, insights, relationships, and more. This will play out in pharma, banking, and many other industries across all forms of unstructured data.

As an aside, these types of capabilities are generally only possible when you can deploy a variety of models (both the frontier and lower cost) because of the sheer amount of tokens that go into these use-cases. This is going to be a major value proposition for the applied AI layer.

Anthropic @AnthropicAI 的最强底牌 #Fable5 和 #Mythos5 在 6 月 9 日刚发布，仅仅过了 3 天（6 月 12 日），就因为一份安全报告直接被美国政府下达出口管制指令，导致全球用户遭遇了半个月的突然断供。

如今，6 月 30 日官方正式宣布出口管制解除，Fable 5 将于 7 月 1 日（明天）正式全球🌍重启复活。

🚀 重启：Fable 5 满血复活后的规则变化
经过半个月与美国政府、商务部 AI 标准与创新研究所（CAISI）的极限拉扯与联合测试，Anthropic 终于拿到了“放行条”。但重开之后的 Fable 5，游戏规则变了：

1. 📅 释放时间表与配额限制
全球全面解封：7 月 1 日起，Fable 5 将重新在 Claude 网页端、平台 API、Claude Code 和办公协作工具 Claude Cowork 上同步启用。

白嫖期只有一周：对于 Pro、Max、Team 以及部分企业级用户，7 月 7 日前，Fable 5 将被包含在每周使用限额的 50% 以内；7 月 7 日之后，对不起，想要调用最强模型，必须通过购买额度按量付费。

Mythos 5 依然被高度管制：作为几乎没有安全限制、纯粹用于网络攻防的兄弟模型 Mythos 5，目前仅对通过美方审批的部分美国本土机构开放，普通用户和国际伙伴依旧无法触碰。

2. 🛡️ “补丁”的代价：误杀率大幅飙升
为了说服政府解除管制，Anthropic 在过去两周内紧急抽调兵力，训练了一个全新的网络安全分类器。

防线加强：新分类器能以 99% 以上的成功率死死堵住亚马逊报告里的越狱漏洞。如果你的请求触发了警报，系统会强制把你的提问降级降舱发送给老模型 Opus 4.8 处理。

副作用：官方明确发出预警，由于安全边界被暴力拉大，新补丁会频繁误杀正常的编程和调试请求。这意味着从明天开始，国内外的程序员在用 Fable 5 写常规代码或 Debug 时，可能会频繁遭遇模型的“无理拒绝”。

🛑 回顾：Fable 5 当初为什么被骤然封杀？
这次封禁之所以震惊业界，是因为它不仅针对技术，还直接动用了出口管制这一国家机器手段。

-亚马逊的“明牌背刺”：导致封禁的直接导火索，是亚马逊的研究人员提交了一份报告，证明他们成功“越狱”了 Fable 5 的安全防线。模型不仅找出了软件漏洞，甚至直接写出了如何利用该漏洞进行攻击的恶意剥削代码。美国政府得知后，出于对高级网络武器扩散的恐惧，于 6 月 12 日紧急下达出口管制令。

-宁可错杀的“一刀切”封锁：由于该行政令要求立即限制“外国籍人士”（无论其在美国境内还是境外）访问这两款最强模型，而 Anthropic 在当时根本没有办法在线上实时验证每一个用户的国籍。为了不违法，他们只能采取最极端的自保手段：对全球所有用户，直接拔掉 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的网线。

-Anthropic 的“窦娥冤”：在公告中，Anthropic 实际上隐晦地表达了不满。他们经过内部比对测试发现，亚马逊报告里提到的那种找漏洞、写攻击代码的能力，根本不是 Fable 5 独有的高危国家级网络武器能力。事实上，不管是他们自家的上一代 Opus 4.8，还是竞品 GPT-5.5、甚至是国内月之暗面的 Kimi K2.7，在测试中全部都能写出同样的攻击代码。但没办法，枪打出头鸟，只有刚发布的 Fable 5 被拉去关了禁闭。

tweets.text:
The US Constitution was the most important political innovation ever, but it's missing two important things:

1) A cap on the growth of government spending
2) A requirement for hard-backed currency

Without them, every democracy drifts toward more debt and eventual loss of reserve currency status (see The Changing World Order). The US is $39T in debt, and adding $1T roughly every 100 days, with interest payments now exceeding the defense budget. There is no mechanism to stop it.

Politicians get elected by promising free stuff using other people's money. Some voters get a benefit today, while the negative impact of the spending goes to future generations who can't vote yet. The incentive structure is broken.

What fixes it? A new constitution somewhere on the frontier (Mars, special economic zones, cyberspace), an amendment that aligns incentives in the current system (politically challenging), or hyper economic growth (AI + robotics + crypto) to outpace inflation.

Any stakeholder can propose changes to the Cardano protocol through a CIP. Proposals can be technical, like address formats or transaction metadata, or conceptual, framed as a Cardano Problem Statement (CPS).

of course, markets going up as much as they have is fun too. but this time when i bought things, it felt real and tangible and i can only hope that the people who are really diving in are having as much fun as i am.
